title: Goat Horn in stonecutter
description: Change the song of the goat horn with a stone cutter - NOW 26.1 SUPPORT !
body:
## Description
**Tired of hunting down all the different horns? Make them yourself!**

With this datapack, place a goat horn in a stone cutter to choose the sound you want ! 
__________________________________________________________________________
## Example
![GUI of Stonecutter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eaf6f37599edf1c478a203401f6fcfbbbb24910b.png)
__________________________________________________________________________
_This datapack works for servers and solo play !_
_**Warning** : This datapack only supports vanilla horns. If you install a mod or datapack that adds additional horns, they won't be available in crafting recipes..._
